abstract: Regressed (burnt-out) testicular germ cell tumors (TGCT) are rare clinical situations that are clinically difficult to recognize. This 43-year-old patient was admitted because of a suspicion of prostatic carcinoma, which eventually was followed by transrectal ultrasonography and a CT scan, both of which revealed a large retroperitoneal mass. Surgery showed extensive ureteral and vas deferens infiltration. Pathology was consistent with a classical seminoma. Eventually, testes were normal on palpation but ultrasonography only revealed areas of fibrosis and microcalcifications in the left testis, which was followed by a left orchidectomy. Microscopically, there were extensive areas of fibrosis and only a 2 mm area of seminoma was demonstrated. The few areas of uninvolved testicular tissue lacked lesions of intratubular germ cell neoplasia (IGCNU). Retroperitoneal germ cell tumors are rare in the male and consequently, an origin from an occult testicular tumor should always be discarded by image analysis and eventually a biopsy. Immunologic response may be responsible for tumor involution.
abstract_ja: 退縮性（burnt-out）精巣胚細胞腫瘍は稀な臨床状態であり、臨床的に認識が困難である。43歳の患者が前立腺がんの疑いで入院し、経直腸的超音波検査およびCTにより大きな後腹膜腫瘤が認められた。手術では尿管および精管への広範な浸潤が見られた。病理所見は古典的セミノーマに一致した。精巣は触診上正常であったが、超音波検査では左精巣に線維化と微小石灰化の領域のみが認められ、左精巣摘除術が施行された。組織学的には広範な線維化と、2mmのセミノーマの領域のみが示された。腫瘍の関与のない少数の精巣組織には精細管内胚細胞腫瘍（IGCNU）の病変は認められなかった。後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍は男性では稀であり、そのため潜在的な精巣腫瘍由来の可能性を、画像検査と、必要に応じて生検により常に除外すべきである。免疫学的反応が腫瘍の退縮（involution）に関与している可能性がある。
